definitions.explanation: The beating or pulsing of the heart. Often used figuratively to describe excitement, nervousness, or anticipation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鼓動|こどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}く→速い：00514_hayai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鼓動|こどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: I could hear my own heartbeat in the quiet room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦{直前|ちょくぜん}→直前：13651_chokuzen⟧、⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{鼓動|こどう}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Just before going on stage, my heart was pounding intensely.

notes:
The character {鼓|こ} means "drum," so {鼓動|こどう} literally means "drumming movement," vividly capturing the rhythmic beating of the heart. Frequently used in literary and emotional contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鼓動|こどう}: heartbeat
- {鼓動|こどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{速|はや}まる: heartbeat quickens
- {鼓動|こどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: heartbeat becomes intense
- {鼓動|こどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧: one can hear the heartbeat
- {鼓動|こどう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高鳴|たかな}る→高鳴る：20269_takanaru⟧: heart pounds (with excitement)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脈拍|みゃくはく}→脈拍：17839_myakuhaku⟧: pulse — medical/clinical term for the pulse rate; objective and technical
- ⟦{動悸|どうき}→動悸：06299_douki⟧: palpitations — emphasizes abnormal or uncomfortable rapid heartbeat, often associated with anxiety or medical conditions
- ⟦{拍動|はくどう}→拍動：26245_hakudou⟧: pulsation — more technical, used in medical contexts for the rhythmic beating of the heart or arteries
